title: Never Break Your Fast With Alcohol
hook: The number one mistake with fasting is breaking your fast with alcohol.
body: Don't drink alcohol with your first meal, and don't drink before you eat anything at all. After fasting a while, alcohol absorbs faster, it does more damage to your fat loss and health, and it hits you faster so you feel more drunk. No alcohol until 30 minutes after you've broken your fast. And if you're working during the day, avoid alcohol while working.
close: Leave a comment to let me know if you've ever broken a fast with a drink.
